purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require Necropolis corpse or undead context without treating undead identity as active corpse availability. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: undead unit identity proof when undead context is used
corpse availability or corpse value proof when corpse context is used
friendly undead morale bonus exclusion proof
morale package or trigger ordering proof
corpse context cleanup or idempotence proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: undead classification counted as corpse availability
friendly undead morale bonus counted as dread pressure
generic death event counted as corpse context
enemy morale penalty counted without corpse or undead context
display name or SID substring counted as corpse context
necropolis.enemy-dread-corpse-package.notes: Requires Necropolis corpse or undead context before Dread morale package behavior can pressure enemies; undead identity alone is not corpse availability and friendly undead morale bonuses are forbidden.
